meta.title: Ananta Corporation | Plywood & MDF Supplier in Ahmedabad
meta.description: Ananta Corporation is a trusted plywood, MDF, HMR board, pre-laminated particle board, flush door and smart lock supplier in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. Bulk material supply for interior designers, builders and contractors with reliable delivery.

hero.badge: Authorized distributor of Duroply & Action Tesa
hero.sub: Bulk plywood, MDF, boards, flush doors & smart locks for architects, builders, contractors, interior designers & furniture manufacturers across Gujarat and beyond.

categories.heading: Six categories. One reliable supplier.
categories.sub: Quality-certified materials from authorized brand partners — stocked, priced for bulk, and delivered fast.

items.title: Plywood
items.body: Duroply MR & BWP plywood for furniture, kitchens and wet areas — IS 303 and IS 710 certified.

items.title: MDF
items.body: Action Tesa interior, exterior and HDHMR boards in thicknesses from 1.9 mm to 25 mm.

items.title: Moist Master HMR Board
items.body: High moisture resistant boards engineered for modular kitchens and humid spaces.

items.title: Pre-Laminated Particle Board
items.body: Ready-to-use prelam boards in 150+ colours, woodgrains and textures.

items.title: Flush Door
items.body: Durodoor flush doors — solid block-board core, 100% boiling water proof, termite-resistant.

items.title: Smart Locks
items.body: Tenon smart locks — fingerprint, WiFi, palm-vein and face recognition for every door.

usps.heading: Built on supply you can plan around.
usps.sub: We combine technical material knowledge with dependable logistics, so your projects never wait on materials.

items.title: Technical Expertise
items.body: Engineering-first guidance on detailing and material selection for residential and industrial projects.

items.title: Design + Execution Support
items.body: Close collaboration with interior designers and architects to align design intent with reliable execution.

items.title: Ready Stock Infrastructure
items.body: Ready-to-dispatch inventory backed by 11,000 sq. ft. of warehouse and workshop space.

items.title: Fast Logistics Network
items.body: An established territorial network and supply-chain relationships for efficient delivery and consistent turnaround.
